Name: Qi Fruit Regrowth
Author: TechnicalityCreations
Description:
Qi's Crop is one of the hardest quests in the game, almost to an unbearable point. But with this mod, which makes one simple change, Qi Fruit will regrow after harvest (amount of days it takes is configurable with [b]GMCM[/b]).

[size=6]Compatibility:
[/size]Works with any other mod apart from ones that:
[list]
[*]Do the exact same thing
[*]Retexture the Qi Fruit. Crops will return to the vanilla textures after their first harvest. (Compatibility patch with Vanilla Tweaks - Farming in the works)
[/list]
[b]This mod is translated into French and Spanish by hand by myself: please tell me if there are any errors for I'm not entirely fluent in either.[/b]

If you enjoy this mod, please endorse it; it means a lot to me and helps other people find it.

[b][url=https://github.com/TechnicalityCreations/StardewMods/tree/master/QiFruitRegrowth]SOURCE[/url][/b]
